Income Certificate Requirement The notification refers to income eligibility based on the applicable Uttar Pradesh government instructions. It states annual family income limits of Rs.46,080 for rural areas and Rs.56,460 for urban areas for the relevant income criteria. Only income certificates issued and verified according to the instructions mentioned in the notification will be considered. Caste and Residence Certificates The notification states that residence and caste certificates issued through the tehsil with an online digital signature will be considered, provided online verification is possible.

jobs.title: ISTC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 09 Lead Engineer, Executive and More Posts
jobs.qualification: ISTC Recruitment 2026 eligibility is defined separately for each post in terms of educational qualification and managerial experience. The minimum qualification for all posts must be from an Institute/Examination Board recognised by AICTE/appropriate statutory authority/State/Central Government. Candidates with equivalent qualifications must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by a competent authority. ISTC Engineering Manager Eligibility Qualification: Degree in Naval Architecture Engineering/Marine Engineering/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University. Experience: 15 years of managerial experience in Ship design/Shipyard/R&D organisation, of which 5 years shall be as in charge of the section or department, along with a proven track record of managing shipbuilding or maritime projects. ISTC Lead Engineer (R&D) Eligibility Qualification: Degree in Mechanical Engineering/Naval Architecture Engineering/Marine Engineering from a recognized University. Experience: 12 years of managerial experience in Ship design/Shipyard/R&D organisations, including at least 4 years managing large projects or R&D in Commercial or Defence Shipbuilding/Maritime sectors. ISTC Manager (Training & Skill Development) Eligibility Qualification: Degree in Naval Architecture Engineering/Electrical Engineering/Marine Engineering/Mechanical Engineering/Industrial Engineering/Production Engineering from a recognized University (Master's Degree in Engineering or MBA desirable). Experience: Seven years of managerial experience in the maritime/shipbuilding sector; preference to candidates with at least 2 years of experience in training, skilling or capacity building roles. ISTC Assistant Manager (Technical) Eligibility Qualification: Degree in Naval Architecture Engineering/Marine Engineering/Mechanical Engineering/Electrical/Electronics Engineering from a recognised University. Experience: Three years of managerial experience in a Ship Building Company, Ship Repair Company, Marine-related Company, Port, Engineering Company, Government/Semi-Government Company or Establishment, Ship Design firm, or R&D organisation. ISTC Assistant Manager (Information Technology) Eligibility Qualification: Engineering Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology or Master's Degree in Computer Science/Computer Application/Information Technology from a recognized University. Experience: Three years of managerial experience in installation and maintenance of servers, storage devices and networking equipment, and system installation, configuration, maintenance and troubleshooting in a Shipyard, Port, Engineering Company, Government Undertaking, PSU, Private Sector Company, Bank, or Autonomous Body. ISTC Executive (Finance) Eligibility Qualification: Pass in the intermediate examination of ICAI/Institute of Cost Accountants of India/M.Com/MBA (Finance). Experience: One year of managerial experience in financial matters such as Budgeting, Costing, Banking, Taxation, Finalisation of Accounts, Audit-related matters, Financial Concurrence in procurements, or Compliance in a PSU, Commercial organisation, Engineering Company, or Government/Semi-Government Company/Establishment. ISTC Executive (HR & Administration) Eligibility Qualification: Two-year Master's Degree/equivalent Degree/Diploma/Post Graduate Degree with specialization in HR (e.g., MBA-HR) or Post Graduate Degree in Personnel Management. Experience: Minimum one year of managerial experience in Human Resource/Administration in a PSU, Engineering Company, Government/Semi-Government Company/Establishment, or Private Sector organisation. Note: For candidates working in PSUs/Government/Autonomous bodies in the regular cadre, one year of experience shall be in the immediate lower scale of pay or equivalent, as detailed in the official notification. Post-qualification experience is reckoned as on 18 September 2026.
